evidence: Carries the Validation label, alters src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/consensus/validation.h, and changes major validation functions like ConnectBlock and ActivateBestChain.
rationale: Retires a long-standing architectural hazard where runtime system errors were conflated with consensus and policy invalidity in BlockValidationState. As noted in the description, non-validating functions such as FlushStateToDisk, InvalidateBlock, and ActivateBestChain took validation out-parameters purely for error reporting, and this refactoring untangles runtime failures from block validity while unblocking further validation decoupling (#35570).
